text: There was a GDC talk telling a a story where two bored indie game devs made an AI that churns out throwaway low-quality slot machine games as a joke, but actually earned much more money they they’ve expected (thousands of dollars per day). They jokingly told that the reason for high CPU numbers was their “anti-retention” model, where people get so bored by their game that they would literally click ads to escape into another game! text: If you think that's bad, check out this GDC Talk: [VIDEO] They procedurally generated 1,500+ different iterations on top of the same Unity-based slots shovelware using noun/adjective pairs.
